Since Python 3.10 asyncio.Lock takes no loop at construction (mixins._LoopBoundMixin binds lazily via _get_loop, only when acquire must actually wait), so creation outside a running loop is fine on 3.11-3.14 (3.10+ removed the loop param and get_event_loop at init). The only user is ensure_catalog_confirmed (rule_sets.py:540), called only from tools/query_database.py:674, i.e. within the server's loop (uvicorn.run in transport/http.py:249, a single loop). The lock is therefore only ever bound (on contention) to the server loop. The sole thing that could break is contended use on two different loops, and no shipped caller does that: cli.py's asyncio.run calls are for other flows (verify/other) and do not call ensure_catalog_confirmed. Relied on knowledge of CPython asyncio.locks/mixins, not read from dependency source (stdlib, none supplied), so this rests on stable documented 3.10+ behavior.
